claims.text: OpenAPI is a standard, machine-readable format for describing an HTTP API's endpoints (paths and operations), parameters and request and response shapes; a document may be written in JSON or YAML.
claims.source_hint: OpenAPI Specification, introduction and 'Format' section (JSON or YAML)

claims.text: In ASP.NET Core 10, AddOpenApi (Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi, already referenced by DonHang.Api) registers services that build an OpenAPI document from the app's endpoints: controllers, routes, parameters and the types they read and return.
AddOpenApi() with no arguments registers one document named "v1"; MapOpenApi() maps an endpoint serving it at the default route /openapi/{documentName}.json, i.e. /openapi/v1.json.
claims.source_hint: ASP.NET Core docs, aspnetcore-openapi.md (default document name v1; MapOpenApi default route /openapi/{documentName}.json)

claims.text: The generated document's request/response schemas use the same property names as JSON serialization (camelCase, e.g. priceVnd in the ProductDto schema), so renaming PriceVnd and rebuilding changes the field name in the document.
claims.source_hint: ASP.NET Core docs, openapi/include-metadata.md (schemas follow JsonSerializerOptions); live /openapi/v1.json at stage-2 (components.schemas.ProductDto)

claims.text: At stage-2, DonHang.Api/Program.cs line 73 calls builder.Services.AddOpenApi() and line 112 calls app.MapOpenApi() right after app.MapControllers(); neither is inside an environment check, and DonHang.Api references the Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi package.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang DonHang.Api/Program.cs, DonHang.Api/DonHang.Api.csproj, Directory.Packages.props at tag stage-2

claims.text: At stage-2, Caddy (the reverse proxy answering on localhost:8080: Caddyfile site :8080, web shares the lab network, lab publishes 8080) forwards /openapi/* to the API container, as it does /api/v1/* and /api/v2/*.

scripts/backend/openapi-document.sh (stage-2) runs in the lab box, saves GET /openapi/v1.json to a temp file, prints status and content type, the first 11 lines, then only path and method lines; its captured output is outputs/stage-2/scripts/backend/openapi-document.txt.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang scripts/backend/openapi-document.sh and outputs/stage-2/scripts/backend/openapi-document.txt at tag stage-2

claims.text: GET /openapi/v1.json answers 200 with content type application/json;charset=utf-8, and the one document lists every /api/v1 path and both /api/v2 paths (POST /api/v2/orders, GET /api/v2/orders/{id}).
The 'v1' in /openapi/v1.json is the document name, not the /api/v1 URL prefix; Đơn Hàng's single document named v1 describes endpoints of both /api/v1 and /api/v2.

Built from the code, the document changes with it: a renamed field or new endpoint cannot be forgotten. It describes what the code declares (request bodies, success response types), so a client reads those shapes instead of guessing from examples.
claims.source_hint: ASP.NET Core docs, openapi/include-metadata.md (response metadata from signature, attributes, conventions); live /openapi/v1.json at stage-2

claims.text: OpenAPI is a format written so that programs can read it (people can too); pages that let people browse an API are built on it by separate tools; at stage-2 Đơn Hàng references no such package and serves only the JSON document.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang Directory.Packages.props at stage-2 (only Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi); OpenAPI Specification introduction (documentation generation tools)

claims.text: An OpenAPI document can also be written by hand; a hand-written file can go stale when the code changes without it.
In ASP.NET Core 10 the OpenAPI document is regenerated every time a request reaches the OpenAPI endpoint (no caching by default; Đơn Hàng adds none).
claims.source_hint: ASP.NET Core docs, fundamentals/openapi/aspnetcore-openapi.md 'Cache generated OpenAPI document'

claims.text: The ASP.NET Core Web API project template maps MapOpenApi only in the Development environment (inside an IsDevelopment check); Đơn Hàng's Program.cs has no such check.
claims.source_hint: ASP.NET Core docs, fundamentals/openapi/overview.md; examples/don-hang DonHang.Api/Program.cs at stage-2
